postal_system.assignment_rule: A current Poczta Polska PNA source establishes the five-digit hyphenated code and its published locality/address membership at the source reference time. Syntax, TERYT locality, address point, municipality, district or voivodeship geometry alone does not establish current operator assignment or an areal postal boundary.
postal_system.normalization_rule: Accept exactly five ASCII digits with an optional single hyphen after the first two digits and canonicalize to NN-NNN. Preserve leading zeroes. Reject letters, extra digits and ambiguous partial codes.
postal_system.postcode_area_rule: Area output requires an exact fixed authoritative postal-code Polygon/MultiPolygon feature matched to the canonical PNA and compatible reference time. Administrative boundaries, address/streets points, buffers, hulls, Voronoi/raster cells and synthetic fixtures never substitute for a missing postal area.
postal_system.non_area_rule: Organization, route, P.O.-box, point, address-membership-only and unmatched PNA records remain explicit non-areas unless an authoritative postal-area feature exists. Multiple official search rows do not authorize their envelope or administrative union to be presented as a postal polygon.
postal_system.rights_rule: Poczta Polska states that it owns economic copyrights in System PNA and that electronic PNA lists are sold for defined customer uses with quarterly updates. Public access, a search response or a PDF is not treated as permission to reproduce, transform, store in an AGID database, redistribute or publicly serve the underlying assignment dataset or a derivative.
postal_system.administrative_rule: GUGiK PRG and related official administrative/address sources supply administrative or address context under their own terms. Their geometry is not postal-code geometry and may not be relabelled as PNA area.
postal_system.crs_rule: Every geometry retains source CRS, schema, feature identity and exact release metadata. WGS84 output records a reviewed transform and version; coordinates are never relabelled without transformation.
postal_system.privacy_rule: Only public non-personal postal context may enter an approved artifact. Recipients, customers, occupants, owners, rightsholders, shipment details, credentials and private property records are excluded.

integration.coordinate_flow: coordinate -> pinned authoritative PNA Polygon/MultiPolygon or explicit non-area -> separately sourced address context -> PL AGID cell
integration.postcode_flow: canonical NN-NNN -> current permitted Poczta assignment/exception denominator -> exact authoritative area or explicit non-area -> separately sourced address context -> PL AGID cells
integration.building_output_gate: postal-area evidence never creates a building; building output requires a separate explicit address/building source and exact reviewed relation

quality_gates.pass: Every PNA is canonical NN-NNN text and preserves leading zeroes.
Every current assignment/exception pins source edition, reference date, terms, schema and digest under permission compatible with AGID processing and public serving.
Every areal result is an exact pinned authoritative PNA Polygon/MultiPolygon; organization, route, P.O.-box, point, membership-only and unmatched records remain explicit non-areas.
The area artifact pins provider, URL, edition, reference date, licence, byte length, SHA-256, schema, source CRS, reviewed transform, topology, coverage and exclusions.
The complete current assignment/exception denominator is reconciled code by code to an authoritative area or explicit reasoned non-area.
Voivodeship, district, commune, PRG and address geometry remain context and never become postcode area by proxy.
No recipient, customer, occupant, owner, rightsholder, shipment, credential or private property record is published.
Synthetic fixtures verify behavior but never satisfy production evidence gates.

stages.definition: Country policy, source boundary and synthetic conformance contracts are reviewable; no production Poland data is bundled.

A current complete Poczta Polska PNA assignment and exception denominator is usable under explicit reviewed permission for AGID processing, derivation, storage, redistribution and public serving, and is reconciled to a fixed authoritative Poland postal-code Polygon/MultiPolygon release. Edition, reference date, provider, licence, attribution, byte length, SHA-256, schema, source CRS, reviewed transform, topology, coverage, exclusions and reproducible conversion are fixed in an approved immutable artifact. The real PL API/app normalizes NN-NNN, returns only valid real areas, fits and renders translucent fill with a clear outline, and shows selected code, geometry kind, official/derived/virtual class, source, reference date and confidence; organization, route, P.O.-box, point, membership-only and unmatched codes remain explicit non-areas and no administrative, address, building, buffer, hull, Voronoi/raster or synthetic proxy satisfies M2.
Separately authorized official address and building relations pass identity, licence, privacy, validity, CRS, coverage and correction gates.
